INSERT INTO order_stage_progress (
            order_id, stage_id, status, location_id, notes
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
        ON CONFLICT (order_id, stage_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            status = EXCLUDED.status,
            completed_at = now(),
            location_id = EXCLUDED.location_id,
            notes = EXCLUDED.notes
